name: LinkSquares
summary: AI contract-lifecycle-management platform. Its Contract Intelligence says it automatically extracts 120+ data points from every agreement, including obligation milestones, renewal windows and liability clauses, into a searchable register. For agents it ships a first-party MCP connector in Anthropic's Claude directory (Anthropic verified, August 2026), OAuth; the 14 tools create agreements, handle legal-request intake and search documents. The obligation register is not among them; it is reached through the separate Analyze API. A keyless MCP initialize answered 401 with a Bearer challenge.

payments.notes: Quote-only: the pricing page shows no figure, so priceList points at it and humanBilling is unknown. The press release says the Claude connector is at no additional cost to customers with a LinkSquares Agentic Platform subscription plus a Claude Team/Enterprise plan. No machine-payment protocol.

agentAccess.notes: Not keyless. 2026-11-14, no credentials: POST initialize to the connector URL ai-chat-service.linksquares.com/v1/mcp/external answered 401 with a Bearer challenge (scope mcp); a bare GET answered 405. Users sign in with their own LinkSquares credentials under existing permissions.
